integrity: The finite chain, torus and automorphism calculations are fully reproducible from embedded exact-arithmetic programs. The link from the cubical model to the continuous space uses Prue–Scrimshaw's published stable-equivalence theorem; independent mathematical audit is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two unordered points on the explicitly defined Möbius–Kantor graph. Rational automorphism character is determined but no integral indecomposable representation decomposition is claimed; priority cannot be verified against inaccessible or unindexed work.
title: Shortest-cycle tori and integral symmetry in two-particle Möbius–Kantor configurations
